title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: Numbering Basis of a Borrower's In-Care Check-In
content:
The **numbering basis** from which a check-in confirmed in person by the absent borrower, still in care, is numbered on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile is set by the check-ins already on the profile:

| Check-ins on the profile | Numbering basis |
|---|---|
| the latest recorded check-in cites a supporting document (the facility numbers its contacts against the schedule) | the highest recorded check-in number |
| no check-in is recorded (the opening of monitoring is held as the first contact) | one |
| the latest recorded check-in cites none | the count of check-ins recorded on the profile |

The latest recorded check-in is the check-in on the profile with the latest date; the highest recorded number is the highest check-in number on the profile.

*Hypothetical case.* Two check-ins are recorded, numbered 1 and 4, and the later-dated one cites a facility letter: the numbering basis is 4, the highest number, not the count of 2.
